    FOR ALEJANDRO & THE ANALYSIS TEAM

    Connect your output

    Import one JSON object per line. External records are labeled unverified; missing contexts are never reconstructed.

    {"run_id":"run-1","task_id":"inventory",
 "condition_id":"C0","step":0,"agent_id":"A",
 "response_text":"27 kits remain.",
 "answer_class":"27","model":"your-model"}

    Required: run_id, task_id, condition_id, step, agent_id, response_text. Optional exact context: messages with role/content.

    REPRODUCIBLE HANDOFF

    Take the evidence with you

    Each response links to its observation, communication history, evaluator, model configuration and original event.

    • Raw response and event JSONL
    • Exact visible contexts and message IDs
    • Task definitions and scoring annotations
    • Configuration and model provenance
    • Per-agent answer-class distributions

    The two scenarios use the same log format. Semantic grouping can run independently of the agent harness.
